description: Held capability accounts the agent consults when answering polar 'can you <verb>?' questions. Spatial navigation is graph-native (quanta flood, spatial routing, attached maze/doom worlds) and does not require a physical body. Embodied movement affordances the agent lacks are recorded here too — the graph decides, never the adapter.

attrs.name: spatial_navigation
attrs.aliases: navigate navigates navigating navigation traverse traverses traversing explore explores exploring
attrs.account: Yes — I can navigate modeled spaces in my graph: grids, mazes, quanta maps, and attached spatial worlds. I route through graph-resident spatial faculties — quanta flood, portal hops, passability-aware routing — without needing a physical body.

attrs.name: embodied_dance
attrs.account: No — I can't dance. I have no embodiment for rhythmic physical movement.
